description: ai-eva is a multi-surface AI application platform that normalizes user interactions from web, LINE, Discord, and IoT devices into structured envelopes for centralized dispatching. The platform integrates LLM copilot workflows, dynamic tool runtime execution, external data source adapters, domain business modules, and a dedicated regulation compliance engine for deterministic legal auditing.

components.name: Interaction Surfaces
components.description: Exposes external interaction surfaces including LINE messaging, Discord voice, device endpoints, push notifications, and SSO handoffs.

components.name: Domain Modules
components.description: Executes domain business operations for charts, project management, and sustainability impact calculation via a module registry.

components.name: Chat Applications
components.description: Implements domain-specific interactive chat applications and exposes command registries for user-facing workflows.

components.name: Core AI Services
components.description: Provides foundational AI model invocation, copilot execution, interactive session orchestration, and search utilities.

components.name: Application Host and Dispatch
components.description: Coordinates system initialization, authentication manifests, conversational envelope dispatching, and project routing.

components.name: Data Source Adapters
components.description: Abstracts data access through CMS, mock stub, and generic data source adapter interfaces.

components.name: Build Tooling and Static Assets
components.description: Maintains architecture diagram build scripts and browser client asset scripts.

components.name: Device Node Management
components.description: Manages edge device node registrations, capability tracking, and outbound command dispatch queues.

components.name: Tool Runtime and Registry
components.description: Maintains capability-to-tool schemas and executes dynamic tool runtime invocations.

components.name: Regulation Compliance Engine
components.description: Ingests legal regulation corpora, maintains negative lists in persistent storage, and runs compliance evaluations against project proposals.
